whatsapp.welcome:
Welcome to RAKSHAK Child Safety Helpline. Your report can protect a vulnerable child.

Please select the incident category by replying with a number:
1. Lost Child
2. Unaccompanied Child
3. Trafficking Concern
4. Abuse Concern
5. Other
whatsapp.prompt_category: Please enter a valid option number (1 to 5).
whatsapp.prompt_description: Thank you. Please describe what you observed in detail (appearance, clothing, approximate age, behavior, direction of movement).
whatsapp.prompt_location: Please share the location or landmark (e.g., Platform 3, Mumbai Central Railway Station or share your WhatsApp location pin).
whatsapp.prompt_photo: If you have a clear photo of the child or surroundings, please send it now. Otherwise, reply 'skip' to proceed without a photo.
whatsapp.case_created:
Case successfully registered! Your anonymous/confidential Case ID is: {caseId}

Our verified response network has been alerted. You can track this case anytime by replying 'STATUS {caseId}'. Thank you for being a vigilant guardian.

notifications.new_case: New child safety case reported: {caseId} in {zone}
notifications.assignment: You have been assigned to case {caseId} ({priority} priority)
notifications.escalation: URGENT: Case {caseId} has been escalated for immediate intervention

actions.verify_ground: Human verification required. Dispatch nearest transit safety volunteer or ground team for physical welfare check.
actions.alert_station_desk: Human verification required. Alert Railway Police / Station Child Help Desk immediately.
actions.monitor_perimeter: Human verification required. Coordinate with local CCTV operators and transit security to maintain observation.
actions.escalate_childline: Human verification required. Immediate priority welfare intervention. Escalate to Child Welfare Committee / 1098.
